name: City Gas & LNG
angle: City gas distribution (IGL, MGL, Adani Total Gas) + LNG import terminals (Petronet LNG) + LPG/chemical import terminals (Aegis Logistics). Forces: APM/domestic gas allocation cuts to CGD and the shift to costlier HPHT/new-well gas and spot LNG; CNG pricing power vs EVs and petrol; PNGRB exclusivity expiry and new GA rounds; the 2026 West Asia crisis (Qatar LNG, Hormuz, LPG shock) and spot LNG prices; Petronet Dahej utilisation and new terminals; Aegis tank terminals. KPIs: volumes (mmscmd), CNG/PNG mix, EBITDA per scm, gas cost per scm, terminal utilisation and regas tariff, CNG stations/PNG connections, capex per GA.

key: IT || Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
name: BPO & KPO
angle: Members: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions (IKS, US physician RCM), Sagility (US payer/provider services), Firstsource Solutions (CX/BPM, RP-Sanjiv Goenka), Indegene (INDGN, life-sciences commercialisation), eClerx (KPO for financial services/digital). Forces: GenAI/agentic automation deflating seat-based pricing; US healthcare policy (Medicaid/Medicare Advantage changes, payer margin pressure); US tariffs/visa politics vs services; rupee at ~Rs 94.9/$ tailwind; M&A-led growth; client concentration. KPIs: constant-currency revenue growth, revenue per FTE, EBITDA margin, top-5/10 client share, offshore mix, attrition, DSO, deal wins/TCV.

name: Logistics Solution Providers
angle: CONCOR (rail container, DFC), Delhivery (express parcel, PTL, after the Ecom Express acquisition), Blue Dart (air express, DHL group), BlackBuck (trucker platform/fintech), TVS Supply Chain Solutions (contract logistics, global). Forces: DFC commissioning and rail modal share; National Logistics Policy and logistics cost/GDP; e-commerce parcel volumes and quick commerce; consolidation; diesel prices and the West Asia freight shock; asset-heavy vs asset-light returns. KPIs: TEUs and rail share (CONCOR), shipments/tonnage and yield per kg or shipment, EBITDA margin, utilisation, capex/asset turnover, ROCE, take-rate (BlackBuck).

name: Garments & Apparels
angle: Page Industries (Jockey licence, domestic innerwear brand), Pearl Global (export garment maker, multi-country), Gokaldas Exports (exports, Atraco Africa), Raymond Lifestyle (demerged branded apparel/textiles), Kitex Garments (kidswear exports, Telangana capacity). Forces: US tariffs (IEEPA struck down 20-Feb-2026; Sec 122 10% to 24-Jul-2026; since then 10% Sec 301 on MFN; Bangladesh/Vietnam competition); India-UK FTA and EU FTA; China+1 and Bangladesh disruption; cotton prices and MSP; domestic innerwear demand and channel inventory; PLI for MMF. KPIs: volume growth, realisation per piece, EBITDA margin, export share and US share, capacity (pcs/yr) and utilisation, inventory and receivable days, ROCE.

name: Castings & Forgings
angle: AIA Engineering (high-chrome mill internals for mining/cement, global), PTC Industries (titanium/aerospace castings, Aerolloy), CIE Automotive India (multi-technology auto components, Mahindra CIE), Balu Forge (forgings, defence/rail). Forces: mining capex and AIA conversion from forged balls; aerospace/defence titanium supply chain and PTC capacity; auto cycle (India + Europe via CIE); exports and US Sec 232/301 tariffs; scrap/alloy/energy costs. KPIs: tonnage and utilisation, realisation per kg/t, EBITDA per kg, export share, order book (PTC/Balu), working-capital days, ROCE.

name: Small Finance Banks
angle: LENDER report (lender metrics everywhere): AU Small Finance Bank (universal bank licence status, Fincare merger), Ujjivan SFB, Equitas SFB, Jana SFB. Forces: the microfinance stress cycle 2024-26 and recovery; deposit franchise and cost of funds vs universal banks; RBI repo path (cuts in 2025, hike to 5.50% on 7-Oct-2026); secured vs unsecured mix shift; universal-bank transition rules; PSL and CGFMU guarantees. KPIs: AUM growth, CASA and cost of funds, NIM, credit cost, GNPA/NNPA/PCR, MFI share, ROA/ROE, CRAR, LDR.

name: Travel Services
angle: IRCTC (rail ticketing monopoly, catering, Rail Neer), TBO Tek (B2B travel distribution, global), ixigo (OTA for trains/buses/flights), Thomas Cook India (forex, MICE, holidays, DEI). Forces: IRCTC convenience fees and dependence on Railways policy; the outbound travel boom and forex; airline capacity (IndiGo/Air India) and hotel rate inflation; the 2026 West Asia crisis on Gulf travel and fares; rupee at ~Rs 94.9/$; take rates and B2B vs B2C economics. KPIs: GTV/GBV, take rate, tickets per day (IRCTC), EBITDA as % of GTV, customer acquisition cost, forex turnover, working capital.

name: Industrial Minerals
angle: NMDC (iron ore, Chhattisgarh/Karnataka; Nagarnar steel demerged), Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores (manganese + iron ore + Arjas Steel), Ashapura Minechem (bentonite, bauxite, Guinea), MOIL (manganese ore). Forces: iron ore prices and NMDC price-setting; the mining regime (MMDR, auctions, royalty and the 2024 Supreme Court ruling on state mineral taxes); steel capacity growth toward 300 mtpa; manganese ore prices and ferro-alloy demand; iron ore export duty; logistics (rail, slurry pipelines). KPIs: production and sales (mt), realisation per tonne, cost/t and royalty/t, EBITDA per tonne, reserves/mine life, capex, net cash.

name: Telecom Equipment
angle: HFCL (optical fibre cable, defence), ITI (PSU), Tejas Networks (Tata group; BSNL 4G order), Sterlite Technologies/STL (optical networking, US exposure). Forces: BSNL 4G/5G and BharatNet phase III orders; the global fibre glut 2023-25 then AI data-centre demand; US tariffs and BABA rules; telecom PLI; working capital and BSNL receivables; China competition. KPIs: order book and inflow, revenue and EBITDA margin, fibre km capacity and utilisation, realisation per fkm, receivable days, net debt.

key: Business Services || Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
name: Depositories & Registrars
angle: CDSL (depository), CAMS and KFin Technologies (mutual-fund registrars and transfer agents). Forces: demat account growth and retail participation; SEBI F&O curbs (Nov-2024) and transaction volumes; MF AUM growth and SIP flows; yield compression (price cuts, AMC bargaining power); KYC and issuer businesses; SEBI/AMFI rule changes; the market cycle (Nifty 22,780 on 28-Sep-2026). KPIs: demat accounts and market share, revenue per account, MF AUM serviced and yield (bps), EBITDA margin, non-MF revenue share, cash, payout.

name: Carbon Black
angle: PCBL Chemical (Phillips Carbon, RPSG; Aquapharm), Himadri Speciality Chemical (carbon black, coal tar pitch, battery materials), Rain Industries (calcined petcoke, carbon products, Rutgers Europe). Forces: tyre demand and the replacement cycle; feedstock (CBFS/coal tar) pass-through and the 2026 crude shock; Chinese and Russian supply; anti-dumping on carbon black; speciality and conductive grades for EVs; battery materials (anode, LFP); Rain smelter-linked CPC and European losses. KPIs: volume (tonnes) and capacity, EBITDA per tonne, speciality share, utilisation, net debt/EBITDA, ROCE.

name: Edible Oils
angle: Patanjali Foods (edible oil + foods/FMCG, oil palm), AWL Agri Business (ex-Adani Wilmar, Fortune; Adani exit), Gokul Agro Resources. Forces: import dependence (~55-60%) on palm/soy/sunflower and global price swings; import duty changes (2024 hike, 2025 cut); National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm; branded vs loose; rupee at ~Rs 94.9/$; inventory gains/losses; food/FMCG diversification. KPIs: volume (mt), EBITDA per tonne, branded share, realisation, inventory/working-capital days, ROCE.

name: Water Treatment
angle: VA Tech Wabag (EPC + O&M, desalination, international), Ion Exchange (treatment chemicals, resins, engineering), Enviro Infra Engineers. Forces: Jal Jeevan Mission, Namami Gange and AMRUT funding (and the JJM slowdown), desalination (Chennai, Middle East), HAM projects, industrial water and ZLD, state payment delays, order books. KPIs: order book and book-to-bill, execution, EBITDA margin, O&M share, receivable/working-capital days, net cash.

key: Media & Entertainment || TV Broadcasting & Software Production
name: TV Broadcasting
angle: Sun TV Network, Zee Entertainment, Network18 Media (after the TV18 merger; JioStar). Forces: linear-TV subscriber decline and cord-cutting; the ad market and FMCG ad spend; JioStar (Reliance-Disney) scale; OTT economics (ZEE5, Sun NXT, JioHotstar); TRAI NTO pricing; sports rights; the Zee-Sony merger collapse and governance. KPIs: ad vs subscription revenue, viewership share, OTT subscribers and losses, content cost % of revenue, EBITDA margin, cash.

name: Integrated Power Utilities
angle: Tata Power, Torrent Power, CESC (generation + distribution licences + renewables). Forces: regulated distribution ROE and AT&C losses; discom privatisation (Odisha, UP, Chandigarh); the renewable build-out and solar manufacturing (Tata Power cells/modules); merchant prices; coal costs; peak demand; T&D; net debt and capex. KPIs: regulated equity, ROE, AT&C losses, units sold, installed GW (thermal/RE), PLF/CUF, net debt/EBITDA. Cross-link power-generation.html.

key: Ship Building || Ship Building & Allied Services
name: Shipbuilding
angle: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders, Cochin Shipyard, GRSE (defence shipyards). Forces: Navy orders (P-75I, P-17B, NGC, submarines), Maritime India Vision and the 2025 shipbuilding financial-assistance package, commercial ships (Cochin; European orders), order books and execution, margins and customer advances, valuations. KPIs: order book, book-to-bill, execution rate, EBITDA margin, advances/working capital, cash, ROE. Cross-link aerospace-defence.html.

name: Education
angle: Physics Wallah (PWL; listed 2025; online + offline test prep) and Crizac (B2B international student recruitment, UK focus). Forces: test-prep demand (JEE/NEET), offline vs online economics, coaching-centre guidelines (Jan-2024), student-visa policy in UK/Canada/Australia, rupee, cash burn and unit economics. KPIs: paid users/students, ARPU, centres and revenue per centre, EBITDA margin, student placements and revenue per student, cash.

name: Glass
angle: Asahi India Glass (auto + architectural float glass) and Borosil Renewables (solar glass; Europe subsidiary). Forces: auto production and AIS share of PV glass; float capacity additions and China imports; solar-glass ADD/CVD on China/Vietnam, ALMM and module demand; soda ash and gas costs; Europe losses. KPIs: capacity (tpd), utilisation, realisation per tonne/sq m, EBITDA margin, energy cost per tonne, net debt. Cross-link commodity-chem.html (soda ash).

name: Oil & Gas E&P
angle: ONGC (incl. ONGC Videsh, HPCL/MRPL consolidation) and Oil India (incl. NRL). Forces: crude prices in the 2026 West Asia crisis, windfall-tax history, the APM gas formula (10% of Indian basket, floor/ceiling) and new-well premium, production decline vs KG-98/2 ramp, OALP, subsidy-sharing risk, ESG. KPIs: production (mmtoe, oil vs gas), realisation $/bbl and $/mmbtu, lifting cost, reserve replacement ratio, EBITDA/boe, capex, dividend yield. Cross-link refining.html.

name: Holding Companies
angle: Cholamandalam Financial Holdings (Murugappa: Chola Investment & Finance + Chola MS General Insurance) and Religare Enterprises (Burman takeover, Care Health, Religare Finvest). Forces: the holding-company discount (NAV vs m-cap), look-through earnings, RBI CIC rules, governance and control battles (Religare), listed subsidiary values. KPIs: NAV per share, holdco discount %, look-through PAT, subsidiary contribution, standalone debt, dividends passed through. Cross-link nbfc.html, general-insurance.html, investment-cos.html.
